_about: Extracted performance figures that the gold list did not name, each read against its own passage by the same single reader. 'correct': the figure is stated for that metric as the extractor says (metric, value, observed or goal). 'incorrect': it is not. This judges the extraction of the figure, not whether a reviewer should use it; that is the headline classification, scored separately.

reasons.K232699 ppv/npv 0.35/0.94: 'robust positive predictive value (>35%)' is an observed lower bound in subgroups with high prevalence, not a prespecified goal; the extractor read the '>' as a goal marker.
reasons.K253265 specificity rows: Table 16 rows 'Specificity 221 91.9%' for five additional operating points; the operating-point label is on a different line. The figure is real, flagged table_row, and excluded from headline results.
reasons.DEN200055 ppa rows: Positive percent agreement is a spelled-out secondary endpoint of the GI Genius trial. 0.15 is the non-inferiority margin (a goal); 0.621 is the adjusted estimate for the GI Genius arm, tagged subgroup because of the adjustment wording.
